messages:
Alex Sullivan: quick one — we're scoping a 4-week POC for a mid-market finance customer. They asked for an eval harness + golden dataset + clear success criteria. Customer priorities: extraction accuracy (KVP), summarization fidelity, hallucination <= 1%, latency p90 < 200ms, and a cost target. Also they sent a security questionnaire. Can we confirm what we can commit to and an outline for the prompt/eval set?

Maria Le: thanks — propose we split the POC into 3 tracks: (1) extraction (KVP), (2) doc summarization, (3) reranking for QA. For each track: golden dataset (extraction: ~1k annotated rows; summarization: 500 pairs; rerank: 2k labeled pairs). Prompts: canonical + 3 paraphrase variants + adversarial negatives.

Maria Le: suggested success metrics per track:
- extraction: token-level F1 and EM (give both)
- summarization: ROUGE-L + faithfulness/hallucination check (automated + sampled human review)
- rerank: MRR@10 and top-1 accuracy
Thresholds: extraction F1 >= 86, summarization ROUGE-L >= 38, hallucination rate <= 1%. Also latency p90 < 200ms on our hosted endpoint.

Jordan Kim: engineering notes — for a 4-week POC we recommend Redwood Dedicated small pool (2 x A100 equiv) so we can guarantee p90. For cost optimization we can use a quantized 13B/33B variant for extraction and a mix (13B for rerank, 33B for summarization). We can fall back to a smaller model automatically if capacity spikes. Will need the customer's estimated QPS (they mentioned 20 qps peak?).

Jordan Kim: rough runbook items:
1) ingest golden dataset into eval harness repo
2) run baseline models (redwood/13b-q, redwood/33b-q)
3) compute metrics and produce report + regression gate check
4) schedule customer review demo

Sam Bhatt: adding the eval harness config example — this is what we run in CI to compute gates:
```json
{
  "name": "poc-acme-fin-extraction",
  "tracks": ["extraction","summarization","rerank"],
  "golden_path": "gs://redwood-poc/acme/golden/extraction.jsonl",
  "prompts": "prompts/v1/*.yaml",
  "models": ["redwood/13b-q","redwood/33b-q"],
  "metrics": ["f1","em","rouge_l","hallucination_rate","p90_latency"],
  "regression_gates": {
    "f1_drop_max": 1.5,
    "rouge_drop_max": 2.0,
    "hallucination_increase_max_pct": 0.5
  }
}
```

Sam Bhatt: scoring sketch — we compute per-track normalized scores then a weighted aggregate. Example formula:
final_score = 0.5 * norm(f1) + 0.3 * (1 - norm(hallucination_rate)) + 0.2 * norm(latency_score)
where norm(x) maps metric to 0..1 against target/baseline. Gate rule: any model that causes F1 drop > 1.5 pts OR increases hallucination by >0.5pp fails the gate. We'll also flag >5% regression items for human review.

Priya Rao (security): on the security questionnaire — we can provide SOC2 attestation, SSO details (SAML/OIDC), KMS integration notes (we support customer-managed keys via KMS + HSM). We need the customer to sign the DPA and confirm data residency region. For the POC we can redact logs and use ephemeral storage. I can draft answers for sections 2,3,5,7 — send over the questionnaire doc.

Alex Sullivan: perfect — action items for me: confirm golden data ownership (they will supply 70% and we synth the rest), confirm peak QPS, get signed DPA. For pricing: can someone give a 4-week Dedicated quote with placeholders for model mix?

Jordan Kim: I'll put together a cost estimate and a POC playbook (capacity, expected tokens/day, recommended batching/kv cache config).

Maria Le: I'll draft the prompt set template and a short guide for annotators. Also will prepare a 30-min eval walkthrough script for the customer demo.

Sam Bhatt: repo link to bootstrap (internal): https://git.redwood.ai/poc-evals — includes harness, scoring scripts, and a `templates/prompts` folder. Use `make run-eval` to execute locally against the hosted API.

Alex Sullivan: timeline check — Week 0: onboarding & data ingest; Week 1: baseline runs; Week 2: tune prompts and rerun; Week 3: human review + remediation; Week 4: final report + demo. Is that feasible?

Jordan Kim: yes, feasible. We'll reserve nodes week0 and week1. If they need faster turnaround we can run parallel baselines but cost will increase.

Priya Rao (security): I'll start the questionnaire answers tonight, ping me if they require specific crypto/HSM references.

Alex Sullivan: thanks all — I'll update the customer and attach this plan. Ping me in thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
